item.title: My childhood obsession with Webkinz has been reignited thanks to people hand-making custom plushies for the pets I never had

item.title: Xalavier Nelson Jr, director of Space Baby Warlord Trading Simulator, will never uninstall Warframe and would love to see an Outriders 2: 'I think that game would have been really special'
item.content:encoded: The founder of Strange Scaffold gives us the lowdown on his PC gaming habits.

item.title: Turns out running a profitable zoo is super easy unless you keep blowing those profits on dozens of chickens
item.content:encoded: Visitors in Zoo Life Simulator will pay top dollar to look at anything: a rabbit, a goose, and even a hot dog stand.

item.title: Altera is a hardcore, realistic, unforgiving military survival sandbox, so of course it features penguin soldiers with reflex sights on their heads
item.content:encoded: Finally, someone invented the Humboldt-action rifle.

item.title: XCOM meets Rashomon in Vaunted, a tactical RPG where your characters can rewrite history from their perspective
item.content:encoded: The debut title from Lost Lake Games also lets you switch between turn-based combat and real-time action.

item.title: I'm unsure how much of a detective game Artificial Detective will be, but I enjoyed the bit in the trailer when your character attacks a robot with a massive drill
item.content:encoded: Former Dead Space and Control developers are involved in the project.

item.title: If you're sick of waiting for Ubisoft to make a new Splinter Cell, this newly announced indie stealth game might fill the Sam Fisher-shaped hole in your life
item.content:encoded: Lizard State is inspired by "classic PS2-era games".

item.title: Blippo+ is a campy FMV transmission from another world
item.content:encoded: Turn on, tune in, drop out, and become a retro couch potato.

item.title: Deus Ex: Invisible War's audio director says 'there was room for improvement,' but remains proud of the team's work
item.content:encoded: "It wasn't this '90s cyberpunk Johnny Mnemonic cheese fest that everybody reveled in at that time."

item.title: Resident Evil Requiem patch adds photo mode, and apparently 'Character expressions in some cutscenes have been adjusted to better convey emotion'
item.content:encoded: Some bugs have been fixed too.

item.title: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous' 232 subclasses make it the ultimate RPG for buildcrafting freaks—especially the overpowered Ranger who gets to ride a griffon from level 1
item.content:encoded: By sickos, for sickos.

item.title: 'Early on in the 2000s, we got enamored with consoles and I think certain games didn't make the leap right:⁠' Star Wars Zero Company's director has a theory about why old school PC gaming genres are back with a vengeance
item.content:encoded: "Hopefully people are just [going to say] 'a great game is a great game,' and look at it from that perspective."

item.title: Owlcat says everything in its new Expanse RPG 'will definitely 100 percent be human-made,' but also that generative AI will be used for 'vision coordination' and 'inspiration'

item.title: Mechabellum is a conversation you should be having

item.title: Were PC gamers right to take against Syndicate's FPS reboot? Only one man with an ancient disc copy can find out
item.content:encoded: Imagine a world with ever-so-slightly fewer cyberpunk games. Welcome to 2012.

item.title: Elder Scrolls mobile spinoff Blades is shutting down this summer after eight years, but at least all its store items are ultra-cheap now

item.title: Meta to pay $375 million for 'thousands' of children's safety violations, a whole 0.19% of its 2025 revenue

item.title: Discussion: Is it okay for an MMO expansion's launch to be buggy?

item.title: Baldur's Gate 3 YouTuber discovers 'time travel' glitch that also reveals 4 nude Gales hanging out in your camp for some reason

item.title: Microsoft's Project Helix sounds like it could be better for gamers than the Series X but in a way that is worse for Xbox

item.title: Sintopia, the management sim that smashes together Dungeon Keeper and Black & White, will stand before Steam's pearly gates for judgment in April
item.content:encoded: Team 17's Bullfrog-like strategy game releases next month.

item.title: Forgotten FPS sequel Heretic 2 gets a 'reverse-engineered sourceport' that fixes bugs, improves the framerate and adds 'lots of cosmetic improvements'
item.content:encoded: "The game plays as you remember it."

item.title: Lawn Mowing Simulator 2 takes to Kickstarter with the lushest virtual grass I've ever seen
item.content:encoded: Seriously, look at it.

item.title: Developer of cozy tea shop adventure Wanderstop is shutting down: 'It's a particularly tough time for raising game funds'

item.title: Zero Parades devs knew they didn't want to make another cop game after Disco Elysium: 'How people think of the police these days, it's a bit different'

item.title: Get every Frictional horror game ever made—Penumbra, Amnesia, and SOMA—for just $15 in this screamingly good bundle

item.title: Path of Exile's richest player and item trading kingpin gets banned and pleads with Grinding Gear Games to restore 'more than 1,500 items, some of which can't ever be recreated': 'This is the worst day of my life'
item.content:encoded: The Forbidden Trove's days as a hub for Path of Exile trading may be coming to an end.

item.title: Deus Ex: Human Revolution could've had a track from the original game's composer but it was rejected for not being the 'right fit,' and in hindsight he says they were right

item.title: Soren Johnson on keeping his game studio small: 'You get better games if you take longer to make games'

item.title: The FPS skybox is underappreciated, so let's appreciate some

item.title: D&D Beyond's slick new online character creator lets you make a hero in seconds

item.title: Overwatch reveals that only 32% of players stayed loyal to Winston until the end: 'You are not to be trusted'
item.content:encoded: Snakes don't hiss, they switch sides during the Conquest event.

item.title: Linux kernel maintainer says AI has suddenly become useful for devs: 'We can't ignore this stuff. It's coming up, and it's getting better'

item.title: Out of all of Crimson Desert's baffling design decisions, its playable trio might be the worst offender

item.title: Exclusive deal: Get 77% off a 2-year NordVPN Plus plan, and enjoy 4 months free and an Amazon gift card on top

item.title: This legendary Baldur's Gate 3 exploit has taken my latest solo Durge run to a new level of immersion and god-tier power
